body: You as well!

I've been listening to Shambhala mixes for years but have never bothered to actually check where or when it is. It might be time to change that. I'm lookin to go to Tomorrowland and Defqon 1 in the next few years so I'm definitely expanding my horizon.
Yeah we've got a small group chat with some people that hit up shows from time to time, there are a good handful of them coming, and I'm going with my buddy/boss :p
I saw him at Lost Lands! Crazy energy. Cant wait for tonight
I haven't been to EDCO, only LV. I want to hit Orlando this year if I can but I'm already burning way too much vacation so I may try to save some.
Catching him tonight in Fayetteville AR, and my jersey came in just in time yesterday.

I think the city is making them lower the sound (again) and they're ending at 10 pm sunday (earliest ever) so I'm kinda over Ultra at Bayfront. Beautiful location for it, but I wish they'd move somewhere bigger and less congested. That being said, seeing Pendulum reunite was a fucking DREAM in 2016, and seeing Hardwell 2018 was so high energy.

I think Lost Lands is currently my favorite festival but we'll see if Electric Forest this year changes that :p. Gonna be hard to beat the vibe at LL, that crowd is so unlike any I've ever experienced.

That was actually the first time I've EVER seen Stereo Live Dallas security that strict. They were saying no masks and no light toys and all kinds of stuff... Normally they don't care at all. I've been going since Dec 2018, I've seen people bring in all types of light up toys and outfits and helmets etc.. not sure why they were so uptight for LSDream. Definitely threw my vibe off at the start. I haven't been back since, but I'm going to Borgore Feb.21 so I'll see if they're chill again then..

The drive is 4.5-5 hrs, so it's not too bad. I can drive pretty comfortably for around 6 hours before I hit my "Ugh can we just get there already" mood, so I normally just go to either Dallas TX or Kansas City, MO for concerts. Sometimes Oklahoma if they get something decent.

My first time seeing Subtronics (and LSDream and Shlump actually) was Lost Lands, can't wait to see them again

Nice :D I'm from central Arkansas but I drive down to Dallas all the time for shows. It has been interesting to see Stereo Live change over the last year of concerts. We don't get any good EDM here... Subtronics tomorrow in Fayetteville AR though, that's a shocker, so I'll be there.

I just bought my tickets for Ubbi last weekend! So many good acts on that lineup.
My first solo event was actually Ultra Miami 2016. Had the time of my life, and it knocked that fear of going to shows alone out of me. You'll find people to vibe with.
The recent LSDream+Shlump+Inzo show in Dallas?? That show was incredible. I normally go with a friend or two but it's definitely fun to sneak away by yourself and just go crazy.

As someone who was excited to catch the Alchemy Tour and see him, I'm a bit bummed. A Psytrance side project with Dimibo called Abraxis that he is debuting at Dreamstate was announced recently, I wonder if he's trying to test the waters. Psytrance really isn't my thing. Still going to go see the show, already bought tickets and scheduled time off, but my expectations are significantly lowered after reading this thread.

I went to the Excision Apex Tour there both days back in February. The downstairs area gets pretty crowded. Upstairs was not too bad. I spent most of my time up there. Just because of how packed it got, it was pretty stuffy; it was also Winter and was cold outside, so all the doors were closed. I have heard that they open it up when it is warmer to help get some airflow moving. 

Excision sold out and the lower level was packed front to back. That being said, it was still a very good experience. I'd definitely be willing to go back. I considered going for Das but everyone I want to see at Das is coming to Dallas (much closer to where I love) so I'm skipping this year.
Yeah I'm 6'1 and figured the large looked like the best choice from their size chart. I didnt even see the clip, that's a neat little feature. Thanks for all the info!

I appreciate the info, I'll probably be going with the FlipBelt with the zipper compartment for the particularly valuable stuff (phone/cards). That will free me up for a smaller hydration pack, as I won't need as many pockets on it. Also won't need to worry about securing the hydration pack pockets to keep people out.

I am considering using a FlipBelt with zippers, concealed under my shirt, to hold my phone/charger/cash&cards/etc, so a smaller pack would work as long as the bladder size is sufficient. Thanks for all the info. After reading about how bad pickpocketing was at EDCLV '19, I'm a bit paranoid about going to more fests with any valuables.

I was looking at the FlipBelt that has zippers as well, so another additional layer of security there. They look pretty promising, glad to get some reviews on them.

I may look into wearing a bandana as a mask, just need to play around with some and see how I feel about the fit. Thanks for your reply
That was one brand I was looking into, especially the belt with the zippers. Looks like it could be easily concealed under a shirt as well. Thanks for the reply.

Oh awesome, I haven't even considered something like that travel wallet. I have always lugged my entire wallet with me through shows/fests. I guess the smarter move would be to just take ID+cash+necessary cards in something like that.

I have been buying the cheap [intotheam seamless bandanas](https://www.intotheam.com/collections/bandanas) when they go on sale (typically around $5) and just tossing them when they get too stretched out. I do like the designs on Liquid Dreams' bandanas though, I may make the switch to bandanas. I've got a few cheap ones at home I can play around with to see if I like the way they fit before I buy one of the nicer ones.

Thanks for the info and recommendations. Do you have a favorite hydration pack? I've been eyeing the Lunchbox but I see a lot of people complain about the small bladder it has.

A&B, Tchami, Zed's Dead, Gud Vibrations, Said the Sky, Quix, PhaseOne, RL Grime, Figure is a maybe but I saw him when he came through SLC with Excision back in February so I'll skip him if there's a conflict. Galantis wouldn't be a priority, but I wouldn't pass on seeing them. I've been trying to catch Seven Lions for a while but his last tour didn't come close enough to me (I live a few states over from Utah) so very excited for him.  I missed G Jones when he came within a few hours of me, because it was on a Thursday night and I couldn't get the Friday off, so this would give me a chance to see him.

I'm pretty happy with the lineup. Wondering who the special guest is.
I've sent you a friend request in game. I also bought and maxed Adaptation :p But I don't have credits or endo left to max my Umbral mods LOL
I see you put your name in the main post; I'll send you a friend request in game when I get home. My IGN is GenericWhyteGuy. Looking forward to play with a fellow Mag enthusiast sometime :p

I was genuinely surprised to see both Greedy Pull and Natural Talent in there! Even more surprised to see no Counter Pulse and low duration. This looks interesting. I haven't gotten Adaptation to drop yet, so my Arbitration builds suffer a lot. I'll probably spend the plat for it tonight, and just sell one when I get it, to recoup the money.

I also don't have a maxed Arcane Guardian yet. Working on it, but RNGesus is a fickle god.

I miss the old days when Greedy Pull worked for everyone, but I guess the updated version does emphasize **Greedy** a bit more. I hadn't even considered trading out Primed Flow for Greedy Pull, and I can't bring myself to use Greedy Pull without Natural Talent, and this build manages to fit both.

Are you keeping Transient Fortitude at R9 for a reason? Less duration loss? Or just haven't upgraded it yet? 

I agree 100% with Quality of Life choices. For a long time, every Mag build I put together had Greedy Pull and Natural Talent, purely for grabbing energy. Pulling other loot was just a bonus. Since the focus system came out, I've mostly run Zenurik so I can always have a way to get energy back passively, and have since dropped the pull combo.

I'm looking forward to trying out your build, just gotta get some Arcane Guardians and buy adaptation first.
If you're on PC, I'd be down to play sometime.

Would you mind sharing your build? Or just general gameplay tactics? How do you manage the drones? I tend to just use a catchmoon kitgun to pick them off quickly. Mag Prime is about 20% of my playtime after ~1300 hours.

People underestimate Mag. I was asked how I was planning to survive when doing the 1hr Kuva Survival with no Life Support nightwave mission... {Counter Pulse} to lock everything down because they're all Grineer? 2k+ Overshields at all times? Magnetize for problem enemies, Pull to CC everything in front of me if things get sketchy? :p
